study.question: Does nonlinear composition of the six historical item fields before feedback-memory compression preserve useful event information beyond the same-capacity transformation after compression?
study.hypothesis: The inspected incumbent first forms signed, target-weighted sums of concatenated item-field embeddings. Its added feedback memory is also additive in item values conditional on those relevance weights. Separate feedback content did not consistently beat collapsed content in round 11, while bound feedback content also failed to beat factorized content in round 10. This motivates testing value representation rather than further feedback separation. A bias-free shared event MLP may retain nonlinear cross-field co-occurrence information that a function of the pooled first moment cannot recover. The narrow hypothesis concerns extra value-side composition at fixed relevance scoring and fixed memory layout; nonlinear event relevance scoring already exists in DIN. No claim of a first nonlinear event model, source-paper reproduction or novelty is made.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 primary text lines 53-85 confirms target-conditioned local activation and weighted pooling. Inherit the adapted scalar relevance scorer; test nonlinear event values in the auxiliary feedback memory while preserving the existing DIN output.

Pinned tokenizer lines 161-211 applies a SiLU MLP to each concatenated sequence event before interaction. Adopt the event-composition idea as a small residual before compression, without its target tokenizer, raw-event interaction stack, separators or sliding-window attention. Original paper detailed text is unavailable through the authorized registry; originality and exact reproduction remain unverified.

Pinned forward lines 113-159 pools history before field tokenization and interaction. The pooled nonlinear arm is a local same-map operator-placement control; it is not a HiFormer reproduction or a whole-model benchmark comparison.

Pinned lines 123-163 initialize task-mask-specific pooled sequence hubs and use layer-wise exchange. Retain the previous local feedback-memory adaptation; vary value composition only, without original/proxy dual flows, task hubs, affine broadcasts or repeated interaction layers.

Pinned forward lines 132-171 projects event tokens and mixes sequence/nonsequence representations. Considered as a broader alternative; no mixed-attention/pyramid or token-specific-FFN mechanism is introduced.

inherited_components: Complete g0-r0011-memory_joint_collapsed model and architecture config, with source SHA256 20e3a3378483d39cea5679650a73e3ce829a53f988a52f910bfcd5209c7b1cf0
Six item-field embeddings, historical action embedding and all user/context embeddings
DIN scalar target relevance, global/rank-bin relation summaries and all existing moment/content/feedback banks
20-position joint/collapsed feedback memory, count channels and masked cross-attention
Static/relation JointBlock and four task towers; host loss remains the sum of four unweighted BCEs
study.proposed_difference: Add a shared bias-free h(x)=W2 activation(W1 x), width 96->32->96, only to the content of the existing feedback memory. For rank-bin t and historical event i, a_ti=temporal_ti*DIN_weight_i*(sum of the four valid historical feedback masks_i)/4/sqrt(7). Let d_t=max(sum_i |a_ti|,1e-12), u_ti=a_ti/d_t and z_t=sum_i u_ti*x_i. Event placement adds d_t*sum_i u_ti*h(x_i); pooled placement adds d_t*h(z_t). The update is broadcast to the four content positions, leaving their individual counts unchanged. Cross placement (event/pooled) with activation (SiLU/linear), producing four standalone modules. When activation is linear, the two operators commute exactly in real arithmetic, including negative weights, zero mass and clamped tiny mass. With SiLU they can distinguish event distributions sharing the same first moment. No signed denominator is used. Empty/invalid history contributes zero. All constructors and forward branches are matched; unused branches have no backward work. W2 starts at zero in a nested fork_rng after all inherited construction, so every cell starts at the parent function and preserves the inherited CPU RNG stream.
predictions: Before training, identical parent parameters plus zero W2 yield parent-equivalent predictions for all four variants. Changing padded item/action IDs or current target action must have no effect; all-empty and physically zero-length histories must remain finite.

For the same arbitrary nonzero composition weights in FP32, event_linear and pooled_linear agree within absolute 1e-5 plus relative 1e-4 on content updates; their gradients should agree within a declared 1e-4 absolute plus 1e-3 relative tolerance on nondegenerate diagnostic inputs. Material larger differences block mechanism interpretation pending numerical diagnosis.

If value composition before compression matters, event_silu should exceed pooled_silu and the two linear controls on validation macro AUC, with a positive placement-by-activation contrast. Rank by the frozen selection rule even if the hypothesis is unsupported.

A gain confined to pooled_silu supports post-compression nonlinear capacity rather than retained event co-occurrence. Similar gains in both linear cells implicate reparameterization/optimization. No gain is an admissible outcome.

Use the existing length bins 0, 1-16, 17-64 and >64 as exploratory diagnostics. A larger event_silu-minus-pooled_silu difference in longer histories is consistent with compression loss, but does not establish it; empty-history changes after training reflect shared-parameter training effects, not direct new history information.
falsifiers: Any use of masked history IDs, target action, current labels or unauthorized inputs; nonfinite forward/loss/gradient; nonzero direct residual for empty/no-feedback history; changed inherited initialization; or failed initial parent-equivalence gate invalidates the implementation.

A material trained linear-placement difference or failed FP32 commutation/gradient diagnostic leaves numerical/optimization alternatives unresolved and prevents attributing nonlinear placement differences to preserved event information.

If event_silu fails to beat pooled_silu and the linear controls, or the placement-by-activation contrast is nonpositive on repeated paired seeds, the proposed event-composition benefit is unsupported in this setting.
A small one-seed gain without repetition is preliminary; no statistical significance, local source-method effectiveness or mechanistic proof is inferred.
Resource cap violations, unavailable host numerical gates or inability to preserve the assessment reserve stop execution; missing execution is not a negative scientific result.
alternative_explanations: Same nominal parameter count does not imply the same functional class; pre-pooling nonlinearity is deliberately more expressive over event distributions.
The linear residual can be absorbed into the existing content projection, so any linear gain may come from factorization, regularization or optimization rather than extra information.

Positive absolute-mass normalization avoids signed division but gives pooled nonlinear processing different sensitivity to signed cancellation. This suite identifies operator order under that declared normalization, not uniquely field co-occurrence.
Identical forward kernels do not equalize effective backward work; dense gradients and the fixed single-pass schedule can create different optimization/cost trajectories.

Zero W2 inside the already zero-start memory output delays early gradients, and the fixed one-pass recipe may undertrain the event branch. An unsuccessful implementation does not refute every event representation.
The existing nonlinear DIN relevance score and action-conditioned incumbent paths already carry event interactions; the new branch may be redundant.

Four overlapping historical feedback masks weight multi-feedback exposures more than single-feedback exposures in all cells; this is inherited collapsed-memory weighting, not a count or label-policy change.

Small validation improvements after many adaptive rounds may reflect seed variation or validation adaptation. User-cluster uncertainty and a fresh assessment would be needed for stronger generalization claims; no held-out feedback is authorized here.
